liability_cap: Each party's total liability in any Contract Year is limited to the greater of: (a) [*] Euros ([*] Euros); and (b) [*]% of the total payment due to the Distributor in the relevant Contract Year pursuant to Clause 4 (Payment Terms).
risk_explanation: The agreement contains a liability cap, but the key monetary and percentage figures are redacted, making exposure hard to assess. Termination rights are largely for breach/insolvency/change of control rather than clear termination-for-convenience, which can reduce flexibility. The contract also imposes detailed distribution/compliance obligations and audit rights, increasing operational risk for a small vendor.
